instruction.name: vsll.d
instruction.description: Logical left shift each unsigned 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 64, store the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
